title: Definition of Anarchy
categoryProvenance: owner-maintained categorized export CSV · unique/fallback title match
aiSignal: Anarchy is a political concept referring to a society without a governing state or authority. It advocates for the absence of hierarchical structures, believing that individuals and communities can self-organize and manage their own affairs through voluntary cooperation, mutual aid, and free associations. The term is often associated with the rejection of centralized power, laws, and formal government institutions, although it doesn't inherently mean chaos or disorder as it is sometimes misconstrued. Many anarchist philosophies envision a society based on equality, autonomy, and collective decision-making.
